text:
Maya (People Ops): FYI — after this morning's ATS deploy some folks added as 'shadow'/'observer' can't access candidate docs (resume/attachments). Also training reminder emails for upcoming interviewer shadow sessions didn't go out to observers. Anyone else seeing this?

Sandeep (Recruiter): Yup seeing it. I added @Olivia as 'observer' for 3 interviews and she got the calendar invite but when she clicks candidate page it shows 'no access'.

Jenna (Eng TL): I can repro. Looks like role mapping for observer changed from 'viewer' -> 'limited_view' in deploy diff. Investigating.

Maya (People Ops): This is high priority — training cohort A has 12 shadow interviewers scheduled today. If they can't view notes they can't participate. Any temporary workaround?

Sandeep (Recruiter): Workaround: export candidate packet and attach to calendar invites, but that's manual. Can we bulk backfill permissions while root cause fixed?

ATS-bot: Deploy '2026-06-18T10:02:13Z' rolled to prod. No rollback triggered.

Jenna (Eng TL): Patch idea: re-run role-mapping migration to set observer->viewer. Quick script: `UPDATE role_assignments SET role='viewer' WHERE role='limited_view' AND assigned_as='observer';` Will run in staging then prod if green.

Olivia (Hiring Manager): Appreciate a quick fix. Also training emails — calendar bot didn't send the 24hr reminder to observers. Could be tied to the same flag.

Maya (People Ops): Please @Sandeep coordinate which sessions need immediate export. I'll notify instructors to pause interactive parts. :grimacing:

Jenna (Eng TL): Running migration in prod now (careful with write locks). Will report back in ~10m.

Jenna (Eng TL): Migration completed, 128 observer rows updated. Can someone confirm Olivia can access candidate pages now?

Olivia (Hiring Manager): Confirmed I can see resumes and notes now. Calendar reminders still missing for observers though.

Sandeep (Recruiter): Received 3 failed webhook logs for calendar reminders. Pasting snippet:
```
{ "event": "reminder_send", "recipient_role": "observer", "status": "skipped", "reason": "role_not_notify" }
```

Jenna (Eng TL): Looks like notification filter checks notifyable_roles list. I'll add 'observer' back into the list and roll a small patch.

Maya (People Ops): Thank you. After patch please run a quick audit for shadow sessions today and message instructors to resend materials.

Jenna (Eng TL): Patch deployed. Reminders queued re-send. Logged ticket #POPS-412 for postmortem and add e2e test for observers. Closing thread once verified.

Maya (People Ops): Verified with 4 people; reminders came through. Adding note to training runbook to check observer access after role-related deploys. :white_check_mark:
